routesElsewhere.goesTo: report.combined.run — UC-24-19, the Super Admin alone.

steps.note: One read, against the stock and asset records, showing a valuation or a book value only where one exists (BR-3, BR-4, BR-6). The run is recorded (BR-9).

plan.onFailure: Stop and report. Without the permission, or without a period where the report covers one, nothing runs.
plan.atomicity: A read. It changes nothing (BR-8); the only write is the record of the run (BR-9).

operations.name: report.inventory.run
operations.purpose: Run a stock or asset report from the catalogue.

parameters.name: report_id

resolves.onNoMatch: Refuse. No inventory and asset report this reader may run matches — the catalogue offers only what the role permits.
resolves.onAmbiguous: Ask, naming the matching reports from the catalogue.

parameters.notes: The report, from the catalogue's inventory and asset group: Stock balance with valuation; Stock movement; Items at or below their reorder level; Stock count variance; Outstanding purchase advances; Asset register; Assets by room, person or department; Depreciation schedule; Assets due for maintenance and warranties expiring; Disposals with approvals and proceeds. Only the reports the reader's role permits are offered.

parameters.name: period
parameters.notes: The period, where the report covers one — movements, variances, disposals (BR-2, E2).

resolves.onNoMatch: Refuse. No stock item or category matches.
resolves.onAmbiguous: Ask, naming the matching items and categories.

parameters.name: location_id

resolves.onNoMatch: Refuse. No room, person or department matches.

parameters.notes: A room, a person or a department, for the asset reports. Nothing in the specification creates rooms (OQ-3).

parameters.name: staff_id
parameters.notes: The reader. Every run is recorded against them. Never from the request.

parameters.name: branch_id
parameters.notes: Never from the request, even where the request names a campus or a past year (branch-scope, academic-session-scope).

fields.name: result_id
fields.description: The run. It is taken away with report.export — UC-24-19.

fields.name: parameters
fields.description: The period and scope it ran with, as printed on any output.

fields.name: paged
fields.description: True where the result is paged rather than shown whole.

fields.name: valuation
fields.description: Unavailable, not zero — no feature holds a price for a stock item (BR-4).

fields.name: variances
fields.description: On count variance: the reason and the approver against each (BR-5).

fields.name: disposals
fields.description: On disposals: the approval and the proceeds (BR-7).

errors.meaning: The reader does not hold the permission for this report.
No period was set for a report that covers one.
A valuation was asked for, and stock is not held at value.
errors.note: The column reads unavailable rather than zero (AC-3).

errors.meaning: The depreciation schedule was asked for.
errors.note: It reads unavailable rather than showing a figure nothing produces (AC-4).
Shown empty and said so, rather than appearing to have failed.

operations.writesOnRead: The run is recorded — who ran it, which report and over what scope (BR-9).

planningRules.rule: Never give a stock value or a book value. The valuation reads unavailable, not zero, because nothing holds a price; the depreciation schedule reads unavailable because nothing calculates depreciation. A figure supplied from anywhere else would be the only one in the system (BR-4, E3, BR-6, E4).
Show the reason and the approver on every variance — a variance with neither is a discrepancy nobody investigated (BR-5, AC-2).
Show the approval and the proceeds on every disposal — a disposal nobody approved is what the report exists to reveal (BR-7, A3, AC-5).
Ask for the period where the report covers one — movements, variances and disposals — and never assume it (BR-2, E2).
Never correct anything from a report. A wrong balance is corrected by a stock adjustment (BR-8, E5, AC-7).
Report an empty result as an answer, not a failure.
Say that the run is recorded, and take the report away only through report.export — UC-24-19. There is no route out of its own (BR-9, BR-10).
staff_id and branch_id come from $session. A figure across branches is report.combined.run — the Super Admin's alone.

reversal.statement: A report changes nothing a plan can take back. The record of the run stands (BR-9).
